detail.longDescription: Planes, Trains and A.I. The writer reflects on a nationwide flight grounding initially suspected to involve the FAA’s new AI system, though officials later attributed it to communications problems. They argue AI can be useful but should never operate without human oversight, especially in safety-critical fields. Analog systems and human judgment, they conclude, remain essential during technological failures. https:// theartsybrain.rip/2026/11/13/p lanes-trains-and-a-i/
